تجتبوا (form VIII)
# تَجْتَبُوا (tajtabū) /tad͡ʒ.ta.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَبَى (ijtabā)
# تُجْتَبَوْا (tujtabaw) /tud͡ʒ.ta.baw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَبَى (ijtabā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
